ns2:course.label: Energy Conversion Systems
ns2:course.description: Processes and systems for energy conversion, including power and refrigeration cycles, air conditioning, thermoelectrics and fuel cells; ideal-gas mixtures and psychrometrics. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ME 200.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ME 200.
